from pathlib import Path
import re
import tomllib
from triggarr.models.config import Settings

match = re.search(r'```toml\n(.*?)\n```', readme, re.S)
assert match, 'README TOML block not found'
data = tomllib.loads(match.group(1))
settings = Settings(**data)
assert 'Default' in settings.radarr
assert '4K' in settings.radarr
assert 'Default' in settings.sonarr
assert 'Default' in settings.lidarr
print('README TOML example validates against Settings')
PY
